description: Operon induction by genistein in wild type versus nodW and nodW nwsA mutants, with a nod gene as reference
code:
import requests,re,numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
open("/tmp/a.gz","wb").write(requests.get("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE8nnn/GSE8580/matrix/GSE8580_series_matrix.txt.gz",timeout=60).content)
df=pd.read_csv("/tmp/a.gz",compression="gzip",sep="\t",comment="!",low_memory=False).set_index("ID_REF")
df.index=[re.sub(r"_(at|s_at|x_at|i_at|f_at|r_at)$","",str(i)) for i in df.index]
G={"WT_gen":["GSM212687","GSM212688","GSM212689"],"WT_ctl":["GSM212690","GSM212691","GSM212692"],
   "nodW_gen":["GSM212768","GSM212769","GSM212770"],"d901_gen":["GSM212771","GSM212772","GSM212773"]}
L=np.log2(df[sum(G.values(),[])].clip(lower=1)).groupby(level=0).mean()
num=pd.Series(L.index).str.extract(r"^bl[lr](\d+)")[0]
L=L[num.notna().values].copy(); L["ord"]=num.dropna().astype(int).values; L=L.sort_values("ord")
OP=[f"bll{n}" for n in range(6421,6429)]
out={}
for a,lab in [("WT_gen","WT"),("nodW_gen","nodW"),("d901_gen","d901")]:
    fc=(L[G[a]].mean(axis=1)-L[G["WT_ctl"]].mean(axis=1)).dropna()
    op=fc.reindex(OP).dropna(); obs=op.mean(); k=len(op); v=fc.values
    W=np.array([v[i:i+k].mean() for i in range(len(v)-k+1)])
    out[lab]=(op,obs,(np.sum(W>=obs)+1)/(len(W)+1),fc.get("blr2027",np.nan))
fig,(a1,a2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6),gridspec_kw=dict(width_ratios=[2.3,1]))
labs=["wild type\n+ genistein","nodW mutant 613\n+ genistein","nodW nwsA $\\Delta$901\n+ genistein\n(nwsB overexpressed)"]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.105; keys=["WT","nodW","d901"]
for i,g in enumerate(OP):
    a1.bar(x+(i-3.5)*w,[out[k][0].get(g,np.nan) for k in keys],width=w,
           color="#c1442e" if g=="bll6422" else "#6f9ac8")
for xx,k in zip(x,keys):
    a1.plot([xx-0.42,xx+0.42],[out[k][1],out[k][1]],color="k",lw=1.4)
    a1.text(xx,out[k][1]+0.12,"mean %+.2f\nP = %.3f"%(out[k][1],out[k][2]),ha="center",fontsize=8)
a1.set_xticks(x); a1.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=8.5); a1.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6)
a1.set_ylabel("log2 fold change vs uninduced wild type")
a1.set_title("bll6421-bll6428 (red: bll6422), eight genes in order\nP from a sliding 8-gene genomic null",fontsize=10)
a1.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
a2.bar(x,[out[k][3] for k in keys],color="#4c7a3f",width=.55)
for xx,k in zip(x,keys): a2.text(xx,out[k][3]+0.15,"%+.1f"%out[k][3],ha="center",fontsize=9)
a2.set_xticks(x); a2.set_xticklabels(["WT","nodW","$\\Delta$901"],fontsize=9); a2.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6)
a2.set_ylabel("log2 fold change"); a2.set_title("nod reference probe blr2027",fontsize=10)
a2.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle("Genistein induction of the fde-like operon needs NodW and is not restored by NwsB overexpression, which does restore nod gene induction (GSE8580, n = 3)",fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.93]); plt.show()
